dedupe_keys.name: crop and irrigation type dataset for moroccan agricultural regions a ground truth resource for earth observation 2023 2025

description: Georeferenced field data on crops and irrigation methods across Moroccan agricultural regions over two seasons, December 2023 to January 2025, described by its authors as a first attempt to share North African irrigation method data freely. The figshare record says it holds land use and land cover polygons with the irrigation method of each plot, georeferenced photos, and Sentinel-2 bands and NDVI time series for each surveyed parcel, added so that categories can be checked against NDVI ranges. Version 2 of 14 July 2025 has three downloadable RAR archives: the crop and irrigation shapefile (0.8 MB), Sentinel-2 bands and NDVI (68 MB) and the photos (about 17.4 GB), free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is surveyed parcels in several agricultural regions of Morocco. Caveats: the number of parcels, regions and irrigation classes are not stated on the record read, and most of the volume is photos. For simulation it provides ground truth to map drip, sprinkler and surface irrigation, which sets the water and energy demand of irrigation networks and pumping in drought planning. Related catalogue records include the ESA WorldCereal harmonised reference data and the Nigeria dry season irrigated cropland maps.
